details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:279-291 | severity=major | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `PR_CHECKS_LAST_TOTAL` is not numerically validated after extraction, unlike `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING`.
  WHY: An invalid or empty extraction can bypass the empty-check-runs grace polling; reviewers disagree on the impact, ranging from a current unsafe merge path to a currently safe default with future-caller risk.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:337-375 | severity=major | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` does not validate or default explicitly empty `max_minutes` and `poll_seconds` arguments.
  WHY: Empty values can cause invalid `sleep` arguments or arithmetic and fail the pipeline.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:357-370 | severity=blocker | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The wait treats an empty check-run list as success after two polling intervals, even when no required check has been observed.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree on severity, from a blocker to a nit; on an unprotected base, checks that have not registered can leave the caller able to enable auto-merge without the intended verification.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2309-2310, 2335-2336 | severity=nit | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The post-wait freshness re-check deferrals set `auto_merge_summary` without emitting the `AUTOFIX_DET_SKIP_MERGE_BOUND ... action=defer reason=base_moved_overlap` log line.
  WHY: Operators tracing deferrals in workflow logs will not see the structured marker for the post-wait path.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2060-2064, 2124-2128 | severity=nit | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The post-wait freshness re-check deferrals use plain `echo` rather than the `::warning::` prefix used by the wait-failed branch.
  WHY: Operators and log scrapers filtering for `::warning::` will miss these deferrals.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:file size reported as 479,532 bytes (post-last-run); CLAUDE.md §27 480,000-byte guard, 50,000-byte headroom target | severity=nit | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The workflow is only about 468 bytes below the 480,000-byte guard, far short of the documented 50,000-byte headroom target.
  WHY: A subsequent change could exceed the guard and cause GitHub to report a zero-job failure run.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When the check-runs library is missing, or the deterministic-skip-merge job cannot verify its helper checkout, auto-merge is refused rather than enabled unchecked."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The updated `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` adds a fail-open stub for `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` that returns 0 if the library is missing.
- requirement: The post-wait freshness-check deferral should emit a matching `action=defer` log line to help operators debug.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (in the deterministic-skip-merge tails)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The `review_autofix.yml` `elif` block defers the merge based on the fresh check but does not emit the `AUTOFIX_DET_SKIP_MERGE_BOUND pr=${PR_NUMBER} head_sha=${PR_HEAD_SHA} action=defer reason=base_moved_overlap` log line that the existing deferral uses.
- requirement: The post-wait re-check deferral should emit a `::warning::` for consistency with other deferral/refusal paths.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The new re-check `elif` branches in `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` use plain `echo` instead of the `::warning::` prefix.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh | line 284-291 (PR_CHECKS_LAST_TOTAL extraction) and line 360 (consumer) | severity=nit | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `PR_CHECKS_LAST_TOTAL` lacks the regex-validation fallback that `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING` has at line 281.
  WHY: When jq output is empty or unparseable, the `${:-1}` default makes the comparison fail and skips grace polling; the reviewer considers this safe in practice but confusing and potentially problematic for a future caller.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | lines 2309-2310 and 2335-2336 (deterministic-skip-merge job, both merge tails) | severity=nit | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The post-wait freshness re-check sets `auto_merge_summary` to "DEFERRED" but does not emit an `AUTOFIX_DET_SKIP_MERGE_BOUND action=defer` log line.
  WHY: Operators debugging a post-wait deferral will not see the matching action marker emitted by the pre-wait deferral.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh | _pr_wait_for_required_checks (lines 337-375) | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function does not validate or provide defaults for `max_minutes` and `poll_seconds` if they are explicitly passed as empty strings.
  WHY: Empty values can result in invalid `sleep` arguments or incorrect arithmetic, leading to pipeline failures.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh | _pr_wait_for_required_checks (lines 351, 360, 368) | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `max_minutes` is 0, the function may return `timeout` immediately without calling `_pr_checks_completed`.
  WHY: With `waited=0`, the comparison `0 >= 0` evaluates to true instantly, bypassing the check.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh | _pr_wait_for_required_checks, lines 360-370 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The wait function returns success after polling twice when no check-runs are registered, even if the required checks were never run.
  WHY: On an unprotected base, `gh pr merge --auto` will merge immediately if no required checks are registered; returning success early for a fresh push allows an unsafe merge.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "When the check-runs library is missing, or the deterministic-skip-merge job cannot verify its helper checkout, auto-merge is refused rather than enabled unchecked." (From changelog)
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Evidence of absence: The updated `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` adds a fail-open stub for `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` that returns 0 (proceeds) if the library is missing. This violates the requirement to refuse auto-merge if verification is impossible.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The post-wait freshness-check deferral should emit a matching `action=defer` log line to help operators debug.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (in the deterministic-skip-merge tails)
  Evidence of absence: The logic in `review_autofix.yml` adds an `elif` block that defers the merge based on the fresh check, but it does not emit the `AUTOFIX_DET_SKIP_MERGE_BOUND pr=${PR_NUMBER} head_sha=${PR_HEAD_SHA} action=defer reason=base_moved_overlap` log line that the existing deferral uses.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The post-wait re-check deferral should emit a `::warning::` for consistency with other deferral/refusal paths.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh
  Evidence of absence: The new re-check `elif` branches in `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` use plain `echo` instead of the `::warning::` prefix.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh | lines ~279-289 (PR_CHECKS_LAST_TOTAL extraction) and the grace check at ~360 (`[ "${PR_CHECKS_LAST_TOTAL:-1}" = "0" ]`) | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `PR_CHECKS_LAST_TOTAL` is assigned from a `jq` extraction without the numeric-validation fallback that the adjacent `PR_CHECKS_LAST_PENDING` uses.
  WHY: If jq returns an empty string, the grace check substitutes `1` and bypasses polling; on a fresh push where CI never registers check-runs and jq fails, the wait returns `ok` and can enable auto-merge without observed CI traffic.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh | lines 357-365 (the empty-check-runs grace) | severity=nit | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The grace returns `ok` after at most two polling intervals even when no required check has been observed registering.
  WHY: A repo with CI configured but no required checks in branch protection can pass through, allowing an untested PR to land after 120 seconds.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | lines 2309-2310 and 2335-2336 (the new post-wait re-check `elif` branches in both deterministic-skip-merge tails) | severity=nit | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The post-wait freshness re-check branches set `auto_merge_summary="DEFERRED..."` but emit no log line.
  WHY: Operators debugging a deferred PR will see no `action=defer` marker for this branch, only the later summary file mention.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh | lines 2060-2064 and 2124-2128 (the new post-wait re-check `elif` branches in both merge/terminal-fix sites) | severity=nit | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The post-wait re-check deferral uses a plain `echo` rather than the `::warning::` prefix used by the wait-failed branch.
  WHY: Log scrapers that key on `::warning::` will not surface this deferral.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | file size reported as 479,532 bytes (post-last-run); CLAUDE.md §27 480,000-byte guard, 50,000-byte headroom target | severity=nit | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The workflow leaves only about 468 bytes of headroom against the 480,000-byte guard, far under the documented 50,000-byte headroom target.
  WHY: The next change may exceed the guard, causing GitHub to produce a zero-job `failure` run for the workflow.

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

  WHY: On an unprotected base, a PR whose CI jobs have not registered check-runs within those intervals returns success from the wait, allowing the caller to enable auto-merge without the checks this change is intended to verify.
